purpose: Selective durable preservation requested by the human; research artifacts, not an integrated deterministic runtime.
live_measurements: Completed/frozen research is retained. All seven research chats are archived. No worker measurement is active; generic Linux count-only smoke is prepared but unexecuted. The coordinator owns integration using the pinned host and existing lock.
compression: gzip entries decompress to the original bytes; original measured manifests/commands retain historical paths. Relocation edits have separate stored hashes and reasons.

qualification.W1: Qualified native plain-data world/protocol; scripted services, no guest control VM.
qualification.W2: Functional Linux/Redis milestone and sensitive clock control; fresh determinism FAILS.
qualification.W3: Qualified synthetic witness/divergence controls; no complete real KVM capture claim.
qualification.W4: Native survey and offhost Redis/Jedis mock fixture are retained; no guest benchmark speed acceptance.
qualification.W5a: Original bare counts/corrected-owner V4 and V6 bounded Linux correctness qualify from a pinned start. Exploratory bare count-only stop passed at 5.19ms; generic Linux count-only and integrated simtests remain unqualified. Enabled-loaded workaround and insufficient-margin overshoot remain rejected.
qualification.W5b: Fixed-site AMD mediation plus pinned JVM source/portable smoke; no general executable admission or Linux JVM acceptance.
qualification.W6: Focused native epoll plus version-pinned etcd/Zen source findings; no executed bug campaign or attributed Zen3 reset cause.
qualification.earlier: Frozen caller-owned bare KVM/IRQ and scoped Linux clock/entropy component fixtures only; no old modeled-Linux implementation.
qualification.Mac: Read-only SDK/API inspection only; no guest execution or backend qualification. Native HVF parked for supported counting/time/topology gaps; local TCG is an optional later experiment.

excluded: superseded modeled-Linux, Unicorn and Python prototypes
one-off refactor/freeze/finalize helpers as active code
bulk vendored upstream code and survey inventories
